purpose: #203: a unary `!` in an HSPICE expression is read as logical not, as HSPICE reads it (measured), so `1k*(!0)` is 1k.

oracle.derivation: `!0` is 1 (HSPICE Y-2026.03-SP2-1, measured 2026-11-15 with a SPRack-written deck; the manual's operator table lists no unary `!`): r1 = 1k, i(v1) = -1/1k = -1e-3 A.
